name: portfolio-v100
description: Root orchestrator for the portfolio-v100 frontend (Vite/React) and backend (Fastify).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix backend start
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "frontend,backend" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
